notes.content:
[b]Hello, I'm TeamOFF.[/b]

In fact, LightOfGallery, which was developed in 2019, has been temporarily discontinued.

I hope you understand that it is difficult to proceed further because it was made during the job preparation period. 

We apologize for not being able to release the finished production.

​

Thank You.

notes.title: About the current situation ...
notes.content:
Hello guys!

I have some news to share.
Maybe, The release of the Light Of Gallery can be delayed much.
The reason is that the team members have a new job from the university student status. 
Therefore, we are looking at a long period of time until the completion of the project.
But someday, we will complete it and show it to you. 
Actually, I can show it to the test stage to some extent, but I did not decide because I want to show it in good quality.

I am very sorry for all of these things, and I sincerely thank all those who have been interested and watched.
I hope to meet you in a good relationship in the near future.

notes.title: Update ~19.04.27
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

We made a new update.
First, I tried to add more content and tried to have a unified design.
Second, I put in various interactions within the game.
Finally, the story was added. I am going to fill more and more contents,
Please expect a lot in the future!
Thank you.

notes.title: 19/02/25. Development delays.
notes.content:
Hi everyone, the development period is longer than expected.
I am very sorry that the development period of our game has become longer than expected. But we are trying our best to get a good work, so I hope you will be kind enough to wait. Thank you.
